sources.quote: Correct, the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.
Chisone is qualified for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5 only.

findings.why: The re-audit restored Chisone's company standing, but it does not approve any part. No controlled record covers BR-225 for Chisone, for the receiving plant, or for the customer. The documents don't link BR-225 to a customer, program, drawing or material. So I can't say whether it is approved or not approved. A person must confirm the part approval, plant and customer, and the BR-225 drawing material.
